title: dots-superkit/live-record-v1
description: One append-only line in live/<DOT>/<agentId>.jsonl. Shape only; whether the line is true, timely and enough to show progress is judged by the coordinator according to the skill and workflows/live-status.md. Exactly these ten fields, all required, no extras. role, model, project and host are non-empty single-line strings because the field names are the contract; the recommended wording for each is in workflows/live-status.md. Lines written before this version that use another time field or miss a field stay in the file as written, are never rewritten, and are read as unconfirmed.

t.description: RFC 3339 UTC timestamp, for example 2026-11-22T20:37:55Z. Fractional seconds and a +00:00 offset are accepted. A line that uses timestamp, time or at instead of t is not a live record.

role.description: Recommended: one of 총괄, 구현, 연구, 디자인, 디버깅, 검토.

model.description: Recommended: 'confirmed <model> <effort>' only when the runtime displays it, otherwise 'requested <model> <effort>; runtime does not display effective'.

project.description: Recommended: the project id the lane belongs to.

host.description: Recommended: vm or local — the host actually used, confirmed by hostname.
